items.source: For internal use by Enhancer only; see the FastMethod class for similar functionality.
items.translation: 仅供 `Enhancer` 内部使用；有关类似功能，请参阅 FastMethod 类。

items.source: Throwable - the bare exceptions thrown by the called method are passed through without wrapping in an InvocationTargetException
items.translation: Throwable - 由被调用方法抛出的原始异常会直接传递，而不会包装在 InvocationTargetException 中

items.source: args - the arguments passed to the intercepted method; you may substitute a different argument array as long as the types are compatible
items.translation: args - 传递给被拦截方法的参数；只要类型兼容，您可以替换为不同的参数数组。

items.source: Classes generated by Enhancer pass this object to the registered MethodInterceptor objects when an intercepted method is invoked. It can be used to either invoke the original method, or call the same method on a different object of the same type.
items.translation: 由 Enhancer 生成的类在调用被拦截的方法时，会将此对象传递给已注册的 MethodInterceptor 对象。它可以用于调用原始方法，或调用同一类型的不同对象上的相同方法。

items.source: Return the FastClass method index for the method used by invokeSuper(Object, Object[]).
items.translation: 返回FastClass中用于invokeSuper(Object, Object[])方法的索引。

items.source: Return the FastClass method index for the method used by invokeSuper(Object, Object[]). This index uniquely identifies the method within the generated proxy, and therefore can be useful to reference external metadata.
items.translation: 返回FastClass中用于invokeSuper(Object, Object[])方法的索引。此索引在生成的代理中唯一标识该方法，因此可用于引用外部元数据。

items.source: Return the name of the synthetic method created by CGLIB which is used by invokeSuper(Object, Object[]) to invoke the superclass (non-intercepted) method implementation.
items.translation: 返回由 CGLIB 创建的合成方法名称，该方法被 invokeSuper(Object, Object[]) 用于调用父类（未拦截）方法的实现。

items.source: Return the name of the synthetic method created by CGLIB which is used by invokeSuper(Object, Object[]) to invoke the superclass (non-intercepted) method implementation. The parameter types are the same as the proxied method.
items.translation: 返回由 CGLIB 创建的合成方法名称，该方法被 invokeSuper(Object, Object[]) 用于调用父类（未拦截）方法的实现。参数类型与代理方法相同。

items.source: Return the MethodProxy used when intercepting the method matching the given signature.
items.translation: 返回用于拦截与给定签名匹配的方法的MethodProxy。

items.source: Return the signature of the proxied method.
Invoke the original method, on a different object of the same type.
items.translation: 调用原始方法，但使用同一类型的不同对象。

items.source: Invoke the original (super) method on the specified object.
items.translation: 在指定的对象上调用原始（父）方法。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the Class was not created by Enhancer or does not use a MethodInterceptor
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果该 Class 不是由 Enhancer 创建或未使用 MethodInterceptor

items.source: obj - the compatible object; recursion will result if you use the object passed as the first argument to the MethodInterceptor (usually not what you want)
items.translation: obj - 兼容的对象；如果将作为 MethodInterceptor 第一个参数传递的对象用于递归，将会导致无限递归（通常这不是您想要的）

items.source: obj - the enhanced object, must be the object passed as the first argument to the MethodInterceptor
items.translation: obj - 增强后的对象，必须是作为第一个参数传递给 MethodInterceptor 的对象。

items.source: the MethodProxy instance, or null if no applicable matching method is found
items.translation: MethodProxy 实例，如果未找到适用的匹配方法则为 null
